gemini.note: Free-tier models probed on the maintainer's key; limits change, check AI Studio. Fallbacks are tried in order for a page refused with finishReason RECITATION after the half-page crops failed.

local.note: MLX models of the maintainer's extractpdf project (offline). A page whose output fails the guard of providers/local.py (a runaway of identical lines, or far too long) is converted again with the fallback: its failure mode (a cut page) is the opposite of ovis's loop.

price_usd_per_mtok.note: unverified: no price is stored; read the current price list before estimating a cost

anthropic.note: Vision-capable Claude models. Use --model claude-haiku-5-5 for bulk pages; the stronger model is the fallback for a page the default refused (stop_reason refusal) after the half-page crops failed.

openrouter.note: Free vision models (ids ending in :free) chosen at run time from GET /models and ranked (Qwen-VL, Gemma, Pixtral, Llama vision, ...); 'auto' walks the chain of the best four. Free plan: about 20 requests per minute and 50 per day without credits; the client keeps 3.2 s between requests and the runner stops at daily_limit (5 kept in reserve). Use --model <id> to force one.
